title: A Siege Under a Sudden Sky
intro: You are standing before a formidable army approaching a revered sanctuary, with every weapon ready and victory seemingly certain. Before the assault can begin, an unexpected power appears overhead, and the contest takes a turn no one foresaw.
clues: We marched with a confidence that no earthly power could shake.
We brought mighty elephants, and our force seemed built around them.
We had come to tear down a revered sanctuary, believing our victory was already certain.
When we reached it, a flock swept across the sky above us.
The birds hurled stones of hardened clay at our warriors.
We were defeated so completely that our mighty force crumbled and scattered like ash.
